asset_requirements.requirement: Caller-supplied turn-detector asset with an observed SHA-256
Exact model variant, revision and build identity
LiveKit Model License text and a written rights decision
Pinned runtime package and Python 3.12.16 pair
Published input geometry, context mode and preprocessing
Rights-qualified turn-labelled cohort with unknown regions
Independent exact-head review, hosted CI and release approval

exact_blockers.blocker: No turn-detector weight or asset with an observed SHA-256 is available offline; obtaining v1-mini or the text model requires installing livekit-agents and downloading runtime-delivered weights.
exact_blockers.reopen_condition: A caller supplies a digest-pinned local model asset whose bytes hash to the declared SHA-256 and whose runtime is installed outside this task.

exact_blockers.blocker: The full v1 multimodal model is remote inference only and requires a LiveKit Cloud project, network access, LIVEKIT_API_KEY and LIVEKIT_API_SECRET; no offline runtime or public weights exist.
exact_blockers.reopen_condition: Either an authorized LiveKit Inference execution is approved for a locked cohort, or v1 is excluded and only a pinned local variant is used.

exact_blockers.blocker: The text and v1-mini models use the LiveKit Model License, not Apache-2.0; the licence text, redistribution terms and output-use terms were not observed or reviewed.
exact_blockers.reopen_condition: The exact licence text and a written rights decision covering local execution and evidence publication are recorded.

exact_blockers.blocker: No rights-qualified conversational corpus with utterance and turn boundaries, mid-turn pauses and explicit unknown regions is staged; no matched cohort or label review exists.
exact_blockers.reopen_condition: A frozen speaker/session-disjoint turn-labelled cohort with rights clearance and unknown-region masking is available.

exact_blockers.blocker: The model input geometry is unpublished: the text model consumes transcript tokens and the v1-mini audio input sample rate, hop and preprocessing are not documented as exact values.
exact_blockers.reopen_condition: The exact input contract, preprocessing and frame geometry for the selected variant are published or reproduced from a pinned runtime.

exact_blockers.blocker: No pinned/tested LiveKit host package pair exists; S09 is blocked and Python 3.12.16 compatibility with the required livekit-agents release is unverified.
exact_blockers.reopen_condition: A reproducible host/runtime pair is installed in an isolated environment and its version and import surface are recorded.

exact_blockers.blocker: Per-language calibrated unlikely thresholds are not published as values; only documented aggregate true-positive and true-negative rates exist.
exact_blockers.reopen_condition: Calibration values and the calibration cohort are published or independently reproduced for the selected language set.

exact_blockers.blocker: Independent exact-head review, hosted CI and release approval are absent; no candidate result can be promoted.
exact_blockers.reopen_condition: Exact-head review, hosted CI and explicit release approval are recorded for the frozen artifacts.

gates.requirement: Rights-qualified conversational corpus with utterance and turn boundaries and explicit unknown regions
Frozen speaker/session-disjoint development and held-out partitions with independent label review
Matched identity, fixed-timer, VAD-only and human-endpoint controls with cutoff and end-of-turn delay distributions
Pinned real acoustic/prosodic and semantic turn runtimes, weights and exact revisions
Paced live state, maximum-wait fallback, overlap/barge-in and target-device availability evidence
Opt-in provider intake and independent exact-head review

non_claims: No runnable LiveKit model, weight, asset, package or remote inference was used.

reproduction.comparison: exact SHA-256 over canonical JSON; no tolerance

facts.claim: v1 is a multimodal model served on LiveKit Inference; v1-mini runs locally on CPU and falls back from v1.
The deprecated text model is an open-weights Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct derivative, 396 MB on disk, ~50-160 ms per turn.
facts.scope: documentation only; weights and latency not observed

facts.claim: The text model reports English TPR 99.3% and TNR 87.0% across 14 languages.
facts.scope: documentation only; no cohort and not reproduced

facts.claim: Endpointing defaults are 0.3/2.5 s with the multimodal detector and 0.5/3.0 s otherwise.
The text model and v1-mini use the LiveKit Model License.
facts.scope: documentation only; licence text not observed

stable_fields.acceptance: Apply the analysis acceptance profile; record exact scope, evidence, failure/control results, and remaining release gates. A readiness conclusion with an exact external blocker is an accepted investigation handoff; it does not close the conditional implementation.
stable_fields.deliverable: Verify runnable source, exact assets, permitted scope, task geometry and matched evidence. Then reproduce the exact model/runtime as a caller-supplied-asset reference and add an opt-in SDK adapter once its prerequisites pass. Record a concrete blocker if feasibility fails. Emit endpoint decisions separately from framewise VAD; measure cutoff versus end-of-turn delay.
